name: Cheerful
overview: Scripture reveals that a cheerful, or merry, heart profoundly impacts both our outward demeanor and inner well-being. Proverbs highlights that a joyful spirit brings a cheerful countenance and acts as a healing medicine to the body, contrasting the damaging effects of sorrow and a broken spirit. This joy sustains believers like a continual feast even amid affliction, while good news and the light of the eyes further nourish the heart and strengthen the body. Ultimately, this cheerfulness is a reflection of the good and perfect gifts that come from God, the unchanging Father of lights.
